method: Sequential fresh CPython workers, alternating AB/BA source order, three calls through the existing benchmark_processing.measure per worker. Fixture construction/import and assertions/hashing excluded from raw merge timings. First measured call is separate from two warm calls; it is not OS-cache-cold startup. cProfile runs are outside paired timing.
limitations: CPU merge microbenchmark only; excludes extraction, model work, durable storage/checkpoints, HTTP and WebView. Rich synthetic questions are not a quality evaluation; no user files or database access.
